title: Seat, Cabin and Assisted-Carriage Extras on the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A standard advance seat is free on a fare brand that includes seat selection and is otherwise charged per traveller per segment at the brand's standard seat rate.

## 1. Seats are two products, not one

An extra-legroom seat is charged per traveller per segment at the brand's extra-legroom rate even where standard seats are free, because the two are different products.

## 2. Boarding and onboard inclusions

Priority boarding is free on a brand that includes it and is otherwise charged per traveller per segment. Lounge access, a hot meal and an onboard wifi voucher are included or not included by brand and are never sold separately here.

## 3. The seat-map release point

At the brand's seat-map release point before departure the remaining seats are opened for free selection, and a seat taken after that point carries no charge on any brand.

## 4. Lines of their own

A pet in the cabin, an unaccompanied minor and registered special assistance each follow their own line: the first two at the brand's rate, and special assistance free of charge but only where it is registered at least the brand's lead time before departure.

| The carriage | What it costs | Condition attached |
| --- | --- | --- |
| a pet in the cabin | the brand's pet rate | none stated here |
| an unaccompanied minor | the brand's rate per direction | none stated here |
| registered special assistance | nothing | registered at least the brand's lead time before departure |

## 5. Clause no longer in force

> "An upgrade into a higher cabin is sold only on a brand that allows it, at the brand's co-payment per traveller per segment, and never converts the booking to the higher cabin's brand terms."

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the co-payment collected for a move into a higher cabin on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

Sections 1 to 4 are unaffected and remain in force, as do the seat, boarding and assisted-carriage rates scheduled for each brand.

## 6. Hypothetical readings

On a brand that includes seat selection but whose extra-legroom rate is above zero, a hypothetical party choosing extra legroom pays that rate for each traveller on each segment; had they taken a standard seat instead they would pay nothing, because the inclusion reaches the standard seat alone.

On a brand whose special assistance lead time is 48 hours, assistance registered 49 hours before departure is free; registered 47 hours before departure it does not meet the condition this clause attaches.

superseded_clauses: An upgrade into a higher cabin is sold only on a brand that allows it, at the brand's co-payment per traveller per segment, and never converts the booking to the higher cabin's brand terms.
